units.source_text: 大约是贪近便，不走正门而走这里的门出去，因此浮舟房中也听得见说话声。

en.t: Probably because he wanted the quickest way out, he left by this gate instead of the main entrance, so Ukifune could hear the voices from her room as well.

units.source_text: 但闻声音非常优美，吟咏着富有情趣的古歌而从这里经过。

en.t: His voice was very beautiful as he passed this way, chanting an old poem full of graceful feeling.

units.source_text: 浮舟听了不由地感到讨厌。

en.t: Hearing it, Ukifune could not help feeling repelled.
A fresh horse was led out.

units.source_text: 匂亲王只带十余个值宿人员，进宫去了。

en.t: Prince Niou took only a little more than ten attendants on night duty and went to the palace.
